verdict.rationale: Claude's own Cowork docs say that, with computer use enabled, Claude can navigate your screen directly, clicking, typing and opening apps like a user would. The built-in browser and Chrome extension add the ability to read, click and fill forms on websites. Missing for 10: detail on permissions and safety controls, supported operating systems and apps, how screen perception works, the caveat that computer use is a fallback when no connector exists, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work

citations.quote: When computer use is enabled and Claude doesn't have a connector or tool for what you need, it may navigate to your screen directly—clicking, typing, and opening apps just like you would.
Claude opens sites, reads pages, clicks, types, and fills forms while you watch, with no need to switch windows.
Claude in Chrome is a browser extension that allows Claude to read, click, and navigate websites alongside you.
Claude can take on complex, multi-step tasks and execute them on your behalf.
